purpose: Establish a fair Teacher+IK grasp/traction baseline with handle in reachable domain and actual native-pad contact classification, then expose mouth hardware traction boundary. Do not redesign exterior or train PPO.
why_new_round: 005 is closed5/5. Independent evidence shows handle420→316mm and persistent head_pitch limit saturation; it cannot fairly decide mouth hardware. This round tests experimental validity rather than claiming the cart fixture improves Goose mouth.
payload: same real free20kg box on cart, full tensor, no bindings
teacher: Joint targets through original200Hz physical drive adapter/50Hz commands, original torque-speed/voltage/350W/disabled peaks/slew/closedloop. No online state writes. Local fixed-torso bench clearly labelled, head/neck live.

fixture_probe.scope: Explicit passive mechanical test-fixture hypothesis, no pose servo/lock/extra robot-object constraint. Existing assets stay untouched; spring source/OEM not qualified. If physical handle still leaves reachable domain, stop invalid baseline rather than push head to limit.

trajectory_gate: Find a genuinely collision-free open-jaw pregrasp through finite IK planning; do not start already touching the rod and label it approach.
Use actual cold-rod-defined TCP, native-pad working regions and explicit clearances. Actual pose follows true drive dynamics.
For the meaningful pull/hold interval aim each head/neck joint at least0.10rad away from hard limit; do not project unreachable target and call it fair hardware test.
Jaw-closing force may be regulated using Teacher contact feedback within original drive caps to avoid needless overcompression; this is a declared controller variant, not mouth hardware improvement.
Rod approach/closing path must not simply push the handle down or move the cart before capture.
trial_priority: One positive R4+20kg+8Nnominal resistance Teacher grasp/pull/hold/release under corrected validity protocol.
One matched open-jaw/no-clamp countercheck with same fixture/path/parameters. Do not reuse005 negative for this new fixture.
If capture validity passes, same hardware/cart with20N nominal resistance to locate traction/slip/actuator boundary; otherwise a single targeted validity correction.

Optional last trial only for a justified numerical time-step check or a bounded free-base body-backward start using existing control, never new gait development. No total displacement claim from a local neck motion.
measurement_requirements: Record actual per-contact world position/frame, geom names,6D force and matching pre/post-step states so nativeTPU-pad forces can be distinguished from whole-beak shell/pushing.
Force and contact timestamps aligned; relative rod-center migration is not itself a material tangential-slip integral.
True signed pull/hold cart and cargo displacement, genuine capture/no-release, rod pose, limits and measured continuous drive outputs.
Actual wheel bearing/friction reaction if available;8/20N mapped frictionloss is only a nominal cap, not automatically achieved sustained traction.

Closure residual and penetration remain visible. If hold residual/penetration exceed0.5mm, preserve as numerical validity limitation; do not present as high-precision hardware pass. A smaller dt probe must preserve200Hz drive/50Hz commands and be separately identified.
contact_classifier: A separate read-only geometry specialist may provide native pad domains; no second dynamics executor or source edits.
invariants: All original005 pure contact/no suction/no object teleport/no hardware mutation/qualified-success scope remain. No adoption of grooves,pads or actuator changes before fair evidence.
exit: Return at hard deadline with evidence and exact blockers; no automatic further round. A fair baseline+countercheck and a condition-specific hardware question answered are the goal, not all skills or reliability.
